text:
Sara: Heads-up — Acme Medical procurement sent a formal request for compliance evidence to proceed with the deal. They want SOC 2 Type II (redacted copies OK, attestation preferred), ISO 27001 cert, a pen-test attestation/letter, and confirmation of audit support and BAA for PHI. Also asking for POC timeline and Dedicated pricing. Can someone own artifact delivery and identify any enterprise blockers?

Mike: @Sara quick clarifying Qs — do they require the full SOC 2 report or will an AICPA attestation/bridge letter suffice? Need to know scope (which services are in-scope) and date range. For pen test, do they want the raw findings or only a vendor-signed attestation that no high-risk open findings remain?

Sara: They explicitly said 'redacted copies OK; attestation letter preferred, include remediation status where applicable.' In-scope per the email: "Redwood Inference hosted API" plus "Dedicated deployment for POC". POC target is ~6 weeks (integration + eval). Pricing: they want a committed monthly price for Dedicated for procurement. I'll paste the mail if helpful.

Kiran: For the POC we can provision a single Dedicated GPU pool (1x a100-40GB) for the integration phase, then scale. Rough estimate: ~$12k/month for the pool plus a one-time setup of ~$3k for model onboarding and network setup (if they want Private/VPC). Need expected QPS, typical request size, and whether they need HIPAA/BAA posture. If they're handling PHI, we need to land on BAA and key management options (customer-managed KMS for Private).

Anne: I can coordinate artifacts and legal touchpoints. Plan: 1) require NDA (or add strict DSR to procurement); 2) upload redacted SOC2 and pen-test attestation to our secure bucket; 3) provide a one-page controls summary for procurement. I'll need their procurement contact and any required distribution restrictions.

compliance-bot: Compliance checklist generated: [SOC2_redacted.pdf], [PenTest_Attestation.pdf], [ISO27001_Cert.pdf]. Please confirm last audit dates and cert IDs. Internal link: https://secure.redwood.internal/docs/req-789 (access controlled).

Mike: Also note — if the POC uses Dedicated in their network, pen-test scope should include customer-exposed endpoints. For Private/on-prem we need a network review and a security design review (2-week lead). If they require explicit remediation evidence, we'll need to pull the tracker notes and a brief summary of action items and closure dates.

Sara: Acme's contact: procurement@acmemed.com. They said they will accept redacted reports plus attestation letter. They're expecting a BAA too. Anne — can you start an NDA + upload the redacted artifacts by EOD Wednesday? Kiran — can you supply the POC config snippet and a concise pricing estimate we can include in the procurement packet?

Anne: :thumbsup: I'll draft the NDA and assemble the packet. I'll upload artifacts to the secure link and post the link here when ready. Can @Kiran share a minimal Dedicated config snippet to include? Example we can use in the packet:
```
instance_type: a100-40GB
gpu_pools: 1
reserved_tokens: 2000
max_inflight: 8
```

Kiran: Will DM the exact numbers and put together a short pricing table. Also flag: if they request Private (on-prem) deployment, ops lead time ~2 weeks and we'll need network diagrams and SSH/VPN requirements from their infra team.

Sara: Great — owners: Anne (artifact upload + NDA), Kiran (POC config + pricing), Mike (confirm attestation acceptance & any security notes). I'll follow up with Acme to confirm acceptance and schedule a short demo on Thursday. Thanks, team.
